plain: A man who served with the US Air Force says he saw a Tic Tac, a white oval craft shaped like the mint, being unloaded from a C-130 military cargo plane in the Azores, a group of Portuguese islands in the Atlantic. The story comes from a researcher who goes by UAPGerb. He mentions it only briefly to Michels and holds back the details because he plans to interview the man soon. If true, it would mean the military was moving one of these objects around by plane.
